title: George Gershwin wanted to collaborate with Duke
summary: Bigard says Gershwin proposed a songwriting partnership from the Cotton Club days and Duke refused, wanting to do it all himself.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: No, it evolved through association. You see, a lot of people don't know that Gershwin wanted to collaborate with Duke years ago from the Cotton Club. George Gershwin.
Duke didn't want to. Duke wanted to do it all by himself, but Gershwin wanted to be a partner with Duke.
On any specific project or just generally songwriting?
Just songwriting, that's all. And that would have been terrific, you know, but, no, he didn't want to. And at that time, you know, I mean, a mixture like that would have been fantastic.
